J1.evidence: Source: «أن سيبويه حكى: سلت أسأل بمعنى سألت» (hamza in أسأل). TR writes «سلت أسال» without hamza and without a Mütercim notu: silent correction of the source. The change is linguistically sensible (سِلْتُ أَسَالُ) but must be marked in a note while quoting what is written.

J2.evidence: Source: «سيبويه حكى: سلت أسأل بمعنى سألت» (أسأل with hamza). TR writes «سلت أسال» without hamza and without a Mütercim notu. Likely the correct form of Sibawayh's dialect, but this silently corrects the printed source; needs a note.

tr.fixed_note: Dropped unmarked '(bir lügat)' and 'doğru'; dropped '(türemiş)' and gloss 'aktı'; rendered لأن هذا ليس بتخفيف الهمز literally; سلت أسأل kept as printed with note
tr.verify_note: '(bir lügat)' and 'doğru' removed; سلت أسأل kept as printed with Mütercim notu; complete and faithful, no unmarked additions.

J1.evidence: Source: «سلت أسأل بمعنى سألت»; EN writes «سِلْتُ أسالُ» (no hamza) without a note: silent correction. EN also has unmarked bracketed additions outside notes: '[i.e. «سالَ سائلٌ»]', '[by lightening]', 'hamzated [root]'. These must go inside [Translator's note: ...].

J2.evidence: Source: «سلت أسأل بمعنى سألت»; EN writes «سِلْتُ أسالُ» (no hamza) with no Translator's note. Silent correction of the source text; must be marked in a note.

en.fixed_note: Kept source «سلت أسأل» with Translator's note; moved '[i.e. سال سائل]' into note; removed unmarked '[by lightening]' and '[root]'
en.verify_note: «سلت أسأل» kept as printed with a Translator's note; earlier plain brackets removed or moved into notes; complete and faithful.
